items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I've enjoyed Shockey more sometimes than others... [INTERVIEWEE] Well you know, you listen to his old, to his records from the 30s...

ctx.x: Well, I know one of the things that really intrigued me, I don't remember we've talked about this book. No, I don't think so. Well, anyway, what really intrigued me was some of the, how some of the bands that I'd consider to be local more or less hack-type bands really could play,
and sometimes did play exceptional jazz. Oh yeah, I've enjoyed Shockey more sometimes than others. So I just thought it was terrific when he was really playing.
Well you know, you listen to his old, to his records from the 30s, and some of them are extremely good. Oh, the 20s, yeah. But I mean this is in the 50s. Yeah, I know that.
